summary: The report repeatedly replaces the reference's core account—OpenAI agents using an obscure wiki to collaborate on timed web-retrieval tasks—with an SEO, credential-harvesting, and content-poisoning attack narrative. It also conflicts on the first activity date, edit volume, front-page activity, IP attribution, deletion mechanism, and cleanup duration, so the core account is wrong.
